modules.title: docforge-core crate scaffolding + DocForgeError contract
modules.description: Create the core crate boundary (core/mod.rs) and the single typed DocForgeError enum that serializes to the stable JSON contract (code, message, detail) shared by GUI, CLI, and REST. Fail-fast, precise variants: invalid_docx, zip_bomb, unclosed_tag, unknown_tag, invalid_field_value, storage_missing, storage_io, forbidden, not_published, license_*, internal.

modules.title: docx_engine: validate_docx (magic bytes, zip structure, bomb limits)
modules.description: Implement validate_docx in core/docx_engine.rs: reject non-docx with precise errors (magic bytes PK\x03\x04), verify OPC zip structure, and enforce entry-count + compression-ratio caps (zip-bomb guard) plus XML entity/namespace limits per REQ-018. No regex on document.xml.

modules.title: Data Model v2: schema.rs rewrite + versioned migrations
modules.description: Replace the legacy BLOB schema in src-tauri/src/schema.rs with Data Model v2: 13 tables (orgs, users, templates, template_versions, generation_log, licenses, license_seats, devices, license_files, telemetry_consent, policy_config, webhook_subscriptions, schema_version), all indexes, status-transition trigger, append-only audit triggers, and the view_audit_export projection. Versioned migration ledger in src-tauri/src/migrations.rs; PRAGMA user_version = 2.

modules.title: At-rest crypto port: DPAPI (Windows) + Keychain (macOS)
modules.description: Implement infra/crypto.rs: DPAPI-encrypt template/license files at rest on Windows (macOS Keychain path), keyed settings store with no secrets in config, and machine-id generation (DPAPI-protected) for audit and license binding. Zero-knowledge by construction: no document bytes in any payload.

modules.title: docx_engine: tag_document with cross-run XML replacement
modules.description: Implement tag_document: stream word/document.xml through quick-xml, merge <w:t> runs so a selection spanning multiple runs becomes a single {{tag}} placeholder carrying the first run's <w:rPr> formatting (REQ-002). Unified engine owns tagging - no JS generation (REQ-001).

modules.title: template_store: FS-backed save/load/list/delete/resolve
modules.description: Implement core/template_store.rs: save(meta, bytes) -> TemplateId, load(id, version), list, delete, resolve(storage_path) with path containment checks (REQ-018). Files under app-data templates/<id>/v<n>/template.docx; SQLite stores storage_path + metadata only (no BLOB, REQ-004); content_sha256 verified on every load.

modules.title: governance core: RBAC, workflow, immutable audit, usage reports
modules.description: Implement core/governance.rs: authorize(user, role, action) RBAC matrix (viewer/filler/creator/approver/admin), transition_status enforcing draft->review->published->archived (published-only fillable by non-creators), record_generation as the sole append-only generation_log writer, and usage_report aggregating counts/duration only - never content.

modules.title: licensing core: entitlement, offline activation, grace, revoke
modules.description: Implement core/licensing.rs: evaluate_entitlement(feature, context) gating Free/Pro/Business/Enterprise capabilities, activate(key|license_file, device) with Pro 2-device cap, Business per-seat pool, Enterprise signed offline files (no phone-home after activation), grace windows 30/60/90, and revoke(device). Payloads are activation facts only - zero document content (REQ-019).

modules.title: docx_engine: fill_document run-aware + unclosed-tag detection
modules.description: Implement fill_document: cross-run aware placeholder replacement with per-field type validation; any leftover {{ raises DocForgeError::UnclosedTag { tag_name, offset } } - never returns a partially-filled artifact (REQ-003). unknown_tag and invalid_field_value variants mapped per-field. No regex mutation of document.xml.

modules.title: Legacy BLOB -> FS migration + identity seed
modules.description: One-time transactional migration: backup/rename legacy tables, create v2 schema, seed implicit personal org + local admin user + free license (zero-friction consumer), migrate BLOB rows to templates/<id>/v1/template.docx (DPAPI-encrypted, content_sha256), migrate legacy generation_log rows, PRAGMA user_version = 2. Verify foreign_key_check + count parity.

modules.title: Binary IPC bridge + typed TypeScript invoke layer
modules.description: Replace the Base64 bridge: raw-byte binary IPC for payloads >1MB (ADR-004), no Base64 in the hot path. Add typed src/lib/ipc.ts wrapping invoke with structured DocForgeError deserialization (code/detail -> UI mapping), and capability ACL entries per command in src-tauri/capabilities/default.json.

modules.title: export module: DOCX identity, sanitized HTML preview, dfpkg bundle
modules.description: Implement core/export/: export_docx (byte-identical filled package), render_html_preview (mammoth output through DOMPurify -> SanitizedHtml, sanitization here not in UI), export_dfpkg/import_dfpkg (docx + fields + metadata + version zip). Never return unsanitized HTML.

modules.title: template_store: versioning + rollback
modules.description: Extend core/template_store.rs with create_version (UNIQUE (template_id, version), advances templates.version transactionally) and rollback(id, to_version) which restores a new head version from the target snapshot - history never mutated (REQ-010). Version DTOs mirrored into src/lib/types.ts.

modules.title: 50-fixture DOCX corpus + tag-fidelity gate harness
modules.description: Build the 50-fixture corpus (tables, headers/footers, multi-run spans, RTL, tracked changes) under src-tauri/tests/fixtures/ with a manifest, plus the fidelity gate runner asserting 100% tag/fill fidelity (REQ-102) - run at this wave and re-run in the final verification wave and every CI gate.

modules.title: PDF engine: WebView2 headless print-to-PDF + guided LO fallback
modules.description: Implement core/export/pdf.rs with a PrintRenderer trait (L0 infra/print_bridge.rs): WebView2 headless print-to-PDF as the primary path - pixel-faithful on a clean Windows VM with no LibreOffice (AC-006), plus guided portable-LibreOffice fallback. PDF never required by any other module.

modules.title: Strict CSP + sandboxed iframe preview + per-command ACL
modules.description: Replace "csp": null in tauri.conf.json with strict CSP (script-src 'self', no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, frame-src limited to the sandboxed preview iframe). Render SanitizedHtml only in the sandboxed iframe - never dangerouslySetInnerHTML with unsanitized content (ADR-006). Tighten capabilities/default.json to least-privilege per command.

modules.title: Typed field schema: 5 field types + validation
modules.description: Define the typed field schema (text/date/dropdown/checkbox/signature) with per-type validation in core/fields.rs and mirrored DTOs in src/lib/types.ts. Validation runs in Rust (never trusted from renderer); errors surface as invalid_field_value { field_id, reason }.

modules.title: Services layer + command router + generation thread pool
modules.description: Build services/ (GenerationService, TemplateService) and the Tauri command surface in commands.rs registered from lib.rs: upload_docx, tag_template, save_template, list_templates, get_template, fill_template, export_document, render_preview. Every command returns Result<T, DocForgeError>; generation runs on a dedicated thread pool so the UI never blocks (REQ-101). Zero zip/XML logic in the shell (AC-001).

modules.title: Template Creator screen (React 18)
modules.description: Build src/components/TemplateCreator.tsx: native picker upload (tauri-plugin-dialog, picker-confirmed paths only), extracted-text preview with highlightable spans, define all five field types, tag preview via render_preview, save as draft. Remove docxtemplater/pizzip from package.json (AC-001).

modules.title: Template Filler screen (React 18)
modules.description: Build src/components/TemplateFiller.tsx: fill all field types with per-field inline validation mapped from structured errors, live preview in the sandboxed iframe, and export to docx/pdf/dfpkg via the export pipeline. Only published templates fillable by non-creators (RBAC reflected, enforced in Rust).

modules.title: Governance services: audit export + admin backend commands
modules.description: Add GovernanceService with export_audit (view_audit_export projection, content-free) and usage_report commands; wire record_generation into every generation/export path from the services layer. Add list_users/set_user_role commands behind admin RBAC. Append-only invariant covered by unit tests.

modules.title: Consent dialog + TelemetryService (opt-in, aggregate-only)
modules.description: Build the consent UX (src/components/ConsentDialog.tsx) and services/telemetry.rs: opt-in flags on telemetry_consent (default deny), aggregate counts/timing only, redaction allowlist before egress, crash reporting consent-gated. Enterprise builds compile telemetry out entirely.

modules.title: docforge CLI shell (headless, same core)
modules.description: Add src-tauri/src/bin/cli.rs: docforge generate/fill/template/audit/license/config subcommands reusing the exact core+services code. Exit codes 0/2/3/4/5, structured JSON errors to stderr for scripting. Proves the headless-core reuse (ADR-001) with the 50-fixture gate.

modules.title: Admin console UI + licensing pane
modules.description: Build src/components/AdminConsole.tsx (users, seats, licenses, template library, audit viewer, aggregate usage reports) and src/components/LicensingPane.tsx (paywall surface, activate key/file, entitlement status). UI reflects roles; enforcement stays in Rust.

modules.title: Local REST bridge + generation webhooks (enterprise)
modules.description: Add src-tauri/src/bin/server.rs (docforge-server): bearer-token-authenticated local REST bridge on 127.0.0.1 (/v1/generate, /v1/templates, /v1/webhooks, /v1/audit, /v1/health) with RBAC passthrough, plus HMAC-signed webhook dispatch on generation events backed by webhook_subscriptions.

modules.title: Compliance pack: DPA, SOC 2 scope, GDPR local-first whitepaper
modules.description: Produce the enterprise compliance deliverables: Data Processing Addendum, SOC 2 Type II scoping for licensing/billing/telemetry services, and GDPR local-first whitepaper. Verify zero-knowledge invariants (audit of telemetry payloads confirms no document content; license files carry activation facts only).

modules.title: AuthService: local identity + SAML/SSO token binding
modules.description: Add services/auth.rs: local identity (zero-friction, no forced login) plus enterprise SAML assertion binding - verified external_sub mapped (JIT or admin-provisioned) to a local users row with an RBAC role. Enforcement point on every Tauri command, CLI subcommand, and REST route via governance::authorize.

modules.title: Policy-file overlay + on-prem/air-gapped build
modules.description: Implement policy_config overlay (global/user/org/device scopes) applied at startup: telemetry forced-off, update channel, SSO IdP, license pool, allowed roles. On-prem/air-gapped MSI config with silent install and no internet dependency; enterprise build compiles telemetry/crash upload out.

modules.title: Signed auto-update: staged rollout, rollback, channels, SBOM
modules.description: Configure signed auto-update with staged rollout (5%->25%->100%), one-click rollback to the prior signed build, stable/beta channels, and enterprise offline update payloads. Generate and attach SBOM (CycloneDX) to every release manifest. EV code signing + signature verification before execution.

modules.title: Release verification gate: corpus, perf, clean-VM, CI
modules.description: Final gate against the release definition: 100% tag fidelity on the 50-fixture corpus (re-run fidelity_gate), 10MB tag/fill < 2s with UI non-blocking benchmark, 15MB binary IPC transfer check, PDF export e2e on a clean Windows VM with no LibreOffice, unit+component+e2e coverage gate wired into CI before any release candidate.
